run.command: yardr group set planners model=claude-opus-5-5 arg=--permission-mode arg=auto arg=--effort arg=xhigh
run.description: Change some settings of a group and keep the rest
does: changes the herdr group planners, which stands: kind claude (Claude Code), limit 1; its runner, kind, limit and every other setting are kept.
Kind claude (Claude Code), from its own kind setting.
Model: claude-opus-4 -> claude-opus-5-5, passed as the kind's model flag; a bead's metadata.model still stands before the group's, as today.
Args, literal, in order: "--permission-mode" "auto" "--effort" "high" -> "--permission-mode" "auto" "--effort" "xhigh".
Effort: high (--effort high) -> xhigh (--effort xhigh).
Permissions now: auto preset ("--permission-mode" "auto"); Claude judges each action; asks only about risky ones.
Permissions after the approval: auto preset ("--permission-mode" "auto"); Claude judges each action; asks only about risky ones.
Other settings, kept as they stand: nice=5.
Skills: none, and the card adds none.
Env and login: none set, and the card sets none.
Login: its sessions use the operator's login (pat; no login_for), kept.
Source grants group planners holds, kept and unchanged by the card; one given, taken back or changed before the approval refuses it:
- source tgbridge, plain (no user's credential): health (read).
Flags every agent of kind claude gets (its harness file's flags.always, its memory-off switch, the brief's own args) are outside this card and unchanged: yardr harness show claude.
Its prompt stays roles/planner.md: a depot that keeps .yardr/roles/planner.md gives its beads that file, read at the depot's base commit; any other bead the yard's /synthetic/yard/roles/planner.md.

Its sessions start with the role in /synthetic/yard/roles/planner.md, read now: sha256 38a8d10fdb1bae74166d20bc7f6aec01a0a6378c9cd9b6d1af61b1502014c01c, 34 bytes; a change of that file before the approval refuses it. Its role is:
# Synthetic planner
Plan the work.

Depot app's beads start with its own role, /synthetic/app/.yardr/roles/planner.md, read now: sha256 6999e46830dc6ae735c91b33338944dca0b77be5f7f25797c5fed30688a12824, 33 bytes; a change of it before the approval refuses it. Its role is:
# Depot planner
Plan this depot.

Depot docs's beads start with its own role, /synthetic/docs/.yardr/roles/planner.md, read now: sha256 6999e46830dc6ae735c91b33338944dca0b77be5f7f25797c5fed30688a12824, 33 bytes; a change of it before the approval refuses it. It is the same text as depot app's above.
Sessions the group runs now keep the model and args they started with; sessions it starts after the approval start with these.
Back restores the model and args it has now, by the operator alone; its revision moves on again, sessions started in between keep what they started with, and nothing is written to disk.

weight.line: brings a program the yard will run: the model and args group planners's agents run with
